snippet.title: A Girl Adrift: Reunited Horizon - Grand Opening!!
snippet.description:
Download now!: https://onelink.to/drift
Official Community: https://discord.com/invite/rp8UdxVeU4

■■■■■ Game Introduction ■■■■■
The world of A Girl Adrift returns after 10 years with the 'Reunited Horizon' update!
Please rescue the whale caught in a net during the storm!

The next story of A Girl Adrift, loved by indie game fans for its heartwarming vibes, begins now.
The world has been submerged! Witness the touching friendship between a girl and her whale companion as they drift through a sunken world.

Let's explore a brand-new world while fishing!

■■■■■ Game Features ■■■■■
■ The Next Chapter: Reunited Horizon
A story that picks up where we left off.

■ A Promise Reunited
We promise continuous updates through communication with our players.
Thank you for coming back. From a journey of memories to a journey of new discovery.

■ A Mysterious Game: Start Today, Drift into Tomorrow!
It’s true! I just started for a second, and suddenly it's the next day! (T_T)

■ A New Best Friend: Explore a Wider World with the Whale!
Explore the submerged world alongside your dependable whale companion.
"You're not alone!" Experience a new adventure and a heartwarming story of friendship as you bond with your whale friend.

■ A Feast of Beautiful Melodies: A Healing Jukebox!
Is it for real? Special healing tracks created exclusively for A Girl Adrift by AEYL MUSIC - BEATPELLA HOUSE.

■ Discover the World’s Most Unique Fish!
Beautiful visuals of fish you've never seen before!

■ Is it Fishing? Is it an RPG? It's a Tap RPG Fishing Game!
Infinite growth and collection!
Heal your soul with soft colors, graphics, and soothing sounds.
